Motor Components.name: Copper
Motor Components.reasoning: Copper is the essential conductor material used in motor windings due to its high electrical conductivity; it is universally used in electric motors with no viable substitutes at scale.

Motor Components.name: Steel Ingots
Motor Components.reasoning: Steel is the primary structural material for motor laminations and rotor/stator cores, providing magnetic properties and mechanical strength; steel ingots represent the base material source.

Motor Components.name: Neodymium
Motor Components.reasoning: Neodymium is the critical rare earth element used in permanent magnets inside motor rotors for high magnetic field strength; industry standard with few alternatives in high performance motors.

Motor Components.name: Aluminum
Motor Components.reasoning: Used frequently in motor components like rotor cages and cooling elements due to good electrical and thermal conductivity; more cost-effective than copper in some parts though less conductive, common alternative though copper preferred for windings.

Motor Housing.name: Aluminum
Motor Housing.reasoning: Aluminum is commonly used for motor housings due to its light weight, corrosion resistance, and thermal conductivity; widely used in EV motors for housing structures.

Motor Housing.name: Steel Ingots
Motor Housing.reasoning: Steel can be used for motor housing for mechanical strength, especially in heavy-duty applications, but aluminum is more common for lightweight design; steel is a common alternative to aluminum here.

Bearings.name: Steel Ingots
Bearings.reasoning: Bearings typically use high-grade steel for rolling elements and races due to its hardness, wear resistance and fatigue strength; steel ingots represent base material.

Bearings.name: Titanium
Bearings.reasoning: Titanium can be used in bearings for high strength-to-weight ratio and corrosion resistance, but less common and more expensive; moderate confidence due to niche use.

Bearings.name: Ceramic
Bearings.reasoning: Ceramic materials are used in high-performance bearings for reduced friction and weight; they offer electrical insulation and wear resistance; commonly used in EV motor bearings as options.

Air Cooling System.name: Aluminum
Air Cooling System.reasoning: Aluminum is widely used in heat sinks and fins of air cooling systems due to its excellent thermal conductivity and light weight.

Air Cooling System.name: Copper
Air Cooling System.reasoning: Copper is used in some cooling components due to superior thermal conductivity, but heavier and more expensive than aluminum; less common but possible.
